days.title: Forest Exploration and High Peaks
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Aletschwald
stops.detail: The grey-white of ice and rock contrasting with shades of green in the Aletschwald (forest) provides stunning scenic beauty.

stops.name: Villa Cassel
stops.detail: Villa Cassel looms like an eagle's nest on the Riederfurka ridge, surrounded by the magnificent Valais mountains.

stops.name: Aletschhorn
stops.detail: The highly glaciated Aletschhorn towers over the UNESCO-listed Jungfrau-Aletsch area.

stops.name: Bettmerhorn
